item.title: Behind the Lens: In Conversation with “To Be Continued” Directors | Walk in Hong Kong
item.description: In the cliché-ridden world of 'East-meets-West' marketing, the forgotten legend of Harry Odell, Hong Kong's first impresario, offers a chance to rediscover the city's soul. Flamboyant and boundary-pushing, Odell left a lasting legacy that captures the spirit of a bygone era, prompting a soul-searching journey to define Hong Kong.

item.title: A Decade of Walk in Hong Kong: Reflecting on the Past and Envisioning the Future with Our Co-founders | Walk in Hong Kong
item.description: Founded in 2013 by a group of travel enthusiasts, the company's origins lie in a shared passion for uncovering their city's cultural tales through captivating walking tours. After a decade of growth, we sit down with three co-founders to glean insights from their reflections on the past and their dreams for the future.
